title: UI State Appearance Compiler
description: Verifies interaction state visual spec: all required states defined, focus contrast, disabled opacity, unique visual change per state, skeleton geometry

pipeline.title: Parse Intent
pipeline.description: Extract component list, interaction states, token references for each state

pipeline.title: Verify State Appearances
pipeline.description: Run all gates: required states, focus contrast, disabled, skeleton, unique visuals

pipeline.title: Attest
pipeline.description: Produce signed state artifact for component implementation

gates.title: Spec Valid
gates.description: state-appearance-spec.json exists with components array, each having states

gates.title: States Complete
gates.description: All 6 required states defined for every component: default, hover, focus, active, disabled, error

gates.title: Focus Contrast
gates.description: Focus state specifies a focusRing token or declares minimum 3:1 contrast

gates.title: Disabled Opacity
gates.description: Disabled state uses opacity or a semantic disabled token (not just color change)

gates.title: Unique Visual Change
gates.description: Every state has at least one property that differs from the default state

gates.title: Skeleton Geometry
gates.description: If skeleton state declared, it must reference the same layout dimensions as the loaded state

gates.title: No TODOs
gates.description: No TODO/FIXME/HACK in state spec files

contracts.description: Structural requirements for a valid UI state appearance spec

error_codes.USA003: Focus state does not specify a focusRing or accessible contrast mechanism
error_codes.USA004: Disabled state does not use opacity or semantic disabled token
error_codes.USA005: State has no visual difference from the default state
error_codes.USA006: Skeleton state does not reference layout dimensions of the loaded state
error_codes.USA007: TODO/FIXME/HACK found in state spec files
